newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank rates barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, interbank rates barely changed.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was little changed against the dollar in a tight market this week and riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly steady in quiet trade.
Dealers in the kingdom said there were no major changes in riyal rates but liquidity was low in the market.
They said short-dated deposit rates were at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent. The spot Saudi riyal firmed slightly to 3.7504/06 to the dollar from 3.7505/07 last week.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months were 6-1/16, 5-15/16 and one-year were at 6-5/16, 3/16.
